name: rag-doc-qa
description: Root scripts to install and run the RAG Document Q&A Chatbot (Chroma, backend, frontend) with single commands

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n CHROMA,BACKEND,FRONTEND -c yellow,blue,green "npm run chroma" "npm run backend" "npm run frontend"
